outcome: Correlation between muscle defects and bowel symptoms
cohort: 40 females with different subtypes of ARM, median age 13 (range 4-21)
finding: Females with ARM have considerable defects in the pelvic floor muscles, but these defects do not significantly correlate with bowel symptoms.
mod_finding: Caesarean section should be considered for women with ARM as they have considerable defects in the pelvic floor muscles.
